headline: Callahan's Passage Made Whole as Stlican Shelf Heats Anew
war_summary: Callahan's Passage, which stood nine Warden works of ten at the earlier filing, now stands ten of ten, the last unclaimed post counted Warden. The storm fronts eastward have eased this watch. The Weathered Expanse, which bore sixty-one events across the day, chiefly at Crow's Nest and Wightwalk, shows nothing in the past two hours, its line unchanged at one Warden work, six Colonial and two unclaimed. Palantine Berm, the busiest desk a short while ago, is likewise silent this hour, its seven works all Warden. Stlican Shelf now carries the heaviest traffic: seven Colonial works, one Warden and one unclaimed, its latest event at Port of Rime inside the hour, with Breaker Town the busiest station of the day. Callahan's Passage still grinds, three events in two hours and casualties mounting on both sides. The Nevish Line holds at seven Warden to one Colonial; Stonecradle at eight Colonial to one. Across four hundred and thirty-six counted works the Colonials hold three hundred and seven, the Wardens one hundred and twenty-four, five unclaimed. No victory is declared on this, the five hundred and twenty-third day; thirty-four victory towns remain the mark.
